newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SFE wheat tradeless ahead of production forecast.
newsitem.headline: SFE wheat tradeless ahead of production forecast.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange wheat futures did not trade in a steady market on Monday.
Near-term closing settlement prices were steady while more distant contracts edged back by 50 cents a tonne.
The lacklustre performance followed declines in Chicago wheat and was ahead of Tuesday's official commodities forecast by the Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics.

The official forecasting agency is expected to cut its Australian wheat production forecast for 1997/98 from its previous figure of 19.2 million tonnes because of predicted dry weather throughout Australia's winter and spring.
